coaching.headline: Murdock fed off all five allied heroes: 17 kills, 57713 hero damage and the Core, against builds with zero physical armor stats.

flags.text: Murdock killed Sparrow, Dekker and Lt. Belica four times apiece. A fucking free buffet.
Every Fangtooth, Mini Prime and Orb Prime went to the enemy; Mini Prime fell with no ally dead.
Two of the last four fights opened an ally down, lost 0-3 and 1-2.
Murdock destroyed the duo inner tower, two inhibitors and the Core; the enemy took 11 structures.

focus.title: Armor up and starve Murdock
focus.action: Against a fed Murdock, Dekker and Lt. Belica build physical armor, the duo trades only with Stasis Bomb ready, and the team skips Fangtooth and Prime fights while Murdock is unseen.

18.1.call: Separate plays on three lanes, won 5-2: Lt. Belica killed Gideon and Murdock, Sparrow killed Feng Mao and took the enemy duo outer tower. Every won window should end on a structure.

20.6.call: Feng Mao, Gideon and Murdock killed Crunch, Dekker and Morigesh on the mid lane, lost 0-3. Fangtooth, Genesis Core and two outer towers went to the enemy next; after three quick deaths, concede the pit and guard the towers.

25.8.call: Feng Mao is credited with all three kills, on Lt. Belica, Dekker and Morigesh, lost 0-3, and Fangtooth went to the enemy in the same window. Sparrow had died to Murdock half a minute before; regroup at the tower first.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Two kills on Argus, zero on Murdock, and the duo lane gave up two deaths to zero before minute ten. A damn ugly lane.
Credited with the enemy duo outer tower, the only structure with a recorded allied destroyer, on 10 CS per minute against a norm of 8.3.
Hero damage ran 488 per minute against a norm of 914. Once the enemy duo outer tower falls, join the next mid or Fangtooth fight.
55e7ccc8-b567-4da1-9b09-cdf6a422d816: Fifteen wards against 23 from Argus, three enemy wards cleared, and a hand in 28 percent of team kills.
Landed a kill on Murdock in the won fight deep in the allied jungle, among only three Murdock deaths all game.
When Murdock steps toward Sparrow, drop Containment Fence between Murdock and Sparrow before throwing Stasis Bomb, so the stun lands on a walled-off target.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Team-high 22946 hero damage, 10 CS per minute against a norm of 7.9, and out-earned Gideon 16346 gold to 14520.
Four of six deaths came on the duo lane or offlane; a late duo lane death preceded the mid inner tower and mid inhibitor falling within the minute.
The offlane kill on Murdock answered a Crunch death, and the enemy duo outer tower followed. Rotate to answer ally deaths; otherwise hold mid until the enemy mid outer drops.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Eight wards against a norm near five, two cleared, plus 28468 damage mitigated and 15983 healing on the frontline.
Lost the jungle gold race to Feng Mao, 12985 to 18431, and Feng Mao dealt 44781 objective damage, more than half the enemy total.
Died to Feng Mao outside any detected fight right before the enemy Orb Prime. When Feng Mao shows at a pit, trade the other pit or a tower instead.
bfbe9162-5721-48af-a087-0e123c33735b: First blood and three kills on Narbash, plus the team-high seven kills and all 394 of the team's objective damage.
Seven deaths against a norm near five and a half, with hero damage at 660 per minute against a norm of 943.
When Feng Mao drops off the map, step back toward the offlane tower until a ward or teammate spots Feng Mao again.

matchup: Murdock and Argus held the duo lane: Murdock out-earned Sparrow 22019 gold to 16151.
Long Arm of the Law ignores all physical armor, and Buckshot shreds physical armor.
Argus placed 23 wards, the most in the game, and finished with 14 assists.
build: Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher, Imperator and Terminus match four of six Murdock items; zero of the Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter, Spectra core.
Tainted Rounds cuts healing 45% on basic attacks, the right call into Feng Mao and Narbash healing.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles on damaging a hero below 30% health; Forage with Wind-Rider is Weald's best pair.
Wind-Rider adds attack speed upon leaving Stealth, and Heightened Senses enters Stealth.
Sparrow carry Eternals are a toss-up: Thraex holds the best odds, with Weald, Xyris and Demiurge tied. Sound keep.
augment: Endless Hunt resets basic ability cooldowns on takedowns and permanently grants 1 physical penetration per takedown.
Sun Shards is clearly the field's best Sparrow carry augment: basic attacks ricochet, applying on-hit effects at 35%.
crest: Liberator cleanses all debuffs and grants a short shield, an answer to the Static Trap root.
Pacifier leans ahead of Eviscerator in the Sparrow carry field; Liberator ranks third on the same Sharpshooter Crest path.
improvement: The 56.2% winning core, Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter and Spectra, is the next-game test instead of the Murdock mirror build.
Sun Shards over Endless Hunt is the field-backed augment swap, giving up the takedown cooldown resets.

matchup: Murdock and Argus were the duo opponents; Argus out-assisted Dekker 14 to 3.
Argus dealt 19312 hero damage to 10762 from Dekker.
build: Five magical power items and no armor of either kind, flagged against a three-magical enemy comp.
Tainted Scepter's 45% healing cut answers Feng Mao and Narbash healing, but came last in the build.
Dynamo, the missing winning core piece, adds 30 physical armor, and immobilized enemies take 8% more damage.
eternal: Aion on support is unmodeled; the field clearly favors Lotus on Dekker support, with Weald second.
augment: Nothin' But Net adds gold and magical power when Stasis Bomb damages a hero; best odds in a toss-up with Polarity Strike.
crest: Rift Walkers dashes forward and pulls nearby heroes, and raises the ward cap from 2 to 3.
Reclamation holds the best odds in a toss-up with Leafsong, Silentium and Tranquility; Rift Walkers trails.
improvement: Vanguardian gives nearby allied heroes 15 physical armor and 15 magical armor, a duo answer to Murdock, giving up a damage slot.
Reclamation over Rift Walkers cleanses Dekker and nearby allies, giving up the pull dash.

matchup: Gideon was the mid opponent: a single kill apiece between Lt. Belica and Gideon.
Gideon dealt 12567 hero damage to 22946 from Lt. Belica, yet posted 10591 objective damage to zero.
build: On the full winning core, Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings; the damage path needs no fix.
Caustica ignores 35% of magical armor, useful into the Mistmeadow Buckler on Narbash and Spellbreaker on Argus.
eternal: Aion turns 6% of spell damage on enemy heroes into gold; Bottomless Vial with Runic Focus is Aion's best pair.
Lotus holds the best odds in a toss-up with Xyris on Lt. Belica mid; Aion ranks third.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience; clearly the field's best Lt. Belica mid augment. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer is an active: a shield plus 20% magical lifesteal and movement speed for 8s.
Typhoon leans ahead in the Lt. Belica mid field from the Warlock Crest path; Epoch also ranks above Soulbearer.
improvement: Golem's Gift adds 40 physical armor with 75 magical power, the swap for Caustica if Murdock leads again.
Lotus over Aion is the field-backed Eternal test, giving up the spell gold.

matchup: Feng Mao was the jungle opponent: 8/1/2, with zero Crunch kills on Feng Mao.
Feng Mao posted the game's most healing, 21222.
Murdock killed Crunch three times, Feng Mao twice.
build: Augmentation is the lone winning core item built; Berserker's Axe and Salvation were skipped.
Mutilator adds max-health damage on basic attacks and applies three times per ability hit on heroes.
Aegis Of Agawar grants 10% total armors, 20% below 40% health, yet no item carries a flat physical armor stat.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack: more damage to the mark, less damage taken from the mark.
Most played Crunch jungle Eternal, yet last by edge; Lotus holds the best odds in a toss-up with Marrow.
Savage Strikes with Ferocity edges Alpha's Court with Ferocity as Thraex's best pair.
augment: Combo Crunch grants attack speed when Cross Crunch deals damage, stacking four times; clearly the field's best Crunch jungle augment. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement is an active: area damage plus a heal on hero hits.
Brutallax holds the best odds in a toss-up with Iceskorn Talons; Judgement ranks last. Same Champion Crest path.
improvement: Warden's Faith cuts damage taken from critical strikes by 20% against a crit-stacked Murdock, giving up Mistmeadow Buckler's magical armor.
Lotus over Thraex is the field-backed Eternal swap, giving up the duel mark.

matchup: Narbash was the lane opponent: three Morigesh kills, zero Narbash kills all game, yet Narbash out-earned Morigesh 14264 gold to 12430.
Feng Mao was the offlane problem, credited with four of seven Morigesh deaths.
build: Lifebinder is the lone winning core item built; Timewarp and Tainted Scepter were skipped.
Lifebinder adds magical power and magical lifesteal for every 10% missing health.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles on damaging a hero below 30% health, but Morigesh offlane runs Weald in only 11 field games.
Aion leans ahead of Lotus in the Morigesh offlane field.
augment: Spirit Shred makes basic attacks shred 3.5% magical armor, stacking five times.
Cursed Infestation leans ahead of Ritual Of Death in the field; Spirit Shred ranks third.
crest: Soulbearer leans ahead in the Morigesh offlane field. Sound keep.
improvement: Cursed Infestation over Spirit Shred: Hive gains 12% damage and 10% range, giving up the magical armor shred.
Gaussian Greaves adds 35 physical armor with 55 magical power if Murdock leads again.

threats: Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mark a target → Hive slow → Swarm reposition → Curse execute-burst ult
ourKits.winCondition: Mark + Curse a squishy and delete them with %max-HP Pestilence
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds her marked target
ourKits.playAgainst: she's squishy with one escape (Swarm) — dive after it's used; spread vs Hive

ourKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
ourKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
ourKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
ourKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
ourKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
enemyKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

enemyKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
enemyKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
enemyKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,697 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Murdock carry players this patch (46% of the team's). The damage came from Lightning Hawk, Imperator, Nuclear Rounds.
Long Arm of the Law at rank 3: 95s base, about 79.2s by the end (17% shorter) from 20 ability haste: Nuclear Rounds 20.
Murdock dealt 57,713 hero damage, 46% of their team's, with +287 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Lt. Belica (level 18: about 123 physical armor, 80 after penetration; took 17,017 physical damage from heroes, 68% of all hero damage they took) and Dekker (level 17: about 111 physical armor, 71 after penetration; took 16,401 physical damage from heroes, 62% of all hero damage they took) that is about 24% and 23% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Nuclear Rounds (item): Based on Critical Strike Chance: Increase Ability Damage by 10-20%.
Xyris (Eternal): Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.

Sustain: 22% lifesteal; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; Liberator: Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.; 2,313 healing recorded.

Lesson: Murdock's penetration cut through: Lt. Belica took about 24% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 18 their armor was about 123, about 80 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).
